verdict.rationale: Agora documents its own voice-agent capability: integrating an LLM or existing AI agent with ASR and TTS for real-time voice conversations with interruption handling, plus a backend-plus-client voice agent quickstart. The RTC docs also cover raw audio frame access and publishing media from non-mic sources. However, the pack never explicitly shows a server-side agent joining a channel as a participant that subscribes to live audio and publishes speech back. missing for 10: explicit docs on the agent joining as a channel participant (UID/token), server-side SDK details for subscribing and publishing audio, latency specifics, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, a server-side agent joins a session as a participant that receives live audio and publishes speech back in realtime
